speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You presented with sudden-onset lower abdominal pain; to help me evaluate your condition, can you tell me exactly where the pain is located and if it has moved? Have you experienced any nausea, vomiting, fever, or changes in your bowel habits?

speaker: Patient
text: 16-year-old male. The patient reports the sudden onset of abdominal pain while playing football two hours ago. He has a past medical history significant only for asthma. Additionally, his social history is notable for unprotected sex with four partners in the past month.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Testicular torsion (secondary to recent trauma in a 16-year-old male with sudden onset pain).
